title: Case: Parcel has been routed to the wrong local depot
context: Routing acknowledges the label was sorted to the wrong local depot. Only the receiving depot can confirm the transfer’s physical completion.
initial_request: The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?

events.body: DL-8307 is at North Sedgeglass depot; its destination is Merrow Quay, served by East Copperfin depot. Routing error confirmed. No delivery attempt is scheduled.
The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?
Please transfer DL-8307 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin. Send the destination receipt scan, not just a planned linehaul entry.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Routing control, Heronwick Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Correct-depot receipt does not prove last-mile delivery.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-015: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
